lines.text: Two serious bugs were found in NGINX, the web server behind over 225 million websites.
NGINX is a doorman. It takes each request and sends it to the right app.
lines.title: What NGINX does

lines.text: Both flaws are rated 9.2 out of 10. One had hidden in the code since 2015.
lines.title: How serious

lines.text: Both bugs are in how NGINX handles HTTP/2, a modern way for browsers to talk to servers.
lines.title: The weak spot

lines.text: The flaw is in NGINX itself, so even safe website code can be exposed.
lines.title: Who is at risk

lines.text: Update NGINX, or switch HTTP/2 off until you can. AI helped find these old bugs.
lines.title: What to do

points.text: AI now finds old bugs fast
